speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: For example, rising digital connectivity could result in growing interdependencies across the economic and social domain, and the compromise of digital systems in an economic sector could have security consequences on other sectors.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Inter-agency alignment and coordination are therefore critical in mitigating and tackling these complex and interdependent risks.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: As Singapore’s risks and vulnerabilities evolve, so must our national security capabilities to deal with them.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: This capability building effort takes a WOG approach, covering not only operational and technological aspects, but also public education and communications.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: NSCS will continue to work closely with other Government agencies to achieve this mission.
